# Juan Villamoros

Language: English and Spanish (the site switches language with the ES button).

## Profile (English)

- Role: Software developer. Ruby on Rails, Python, JavaScript, REST APIs, AI agent integration.
- Availability: available immediately, remote, Colombia time (UTC−5).
- Engagements: business-to-business (B2B) through a Colombian company, working name "Juan Villamoros - FullStack Developer S.A.S.", for companies that need a full-stack developer. Juan is the only developer in the company.

### Experience

- SITIC S.A.S. — Support Engineer, 2025 to August 2026. Software and hardware support for retail stores; incident triage and escalation by severity; SLA response-time monitoring.
- Juzto.co — Application Support Analyst, 2023. Support across Zoho CRM, AWS S3 and Supabase; real-time diagnosis; incident documentation.
- BairesDev — Ruby on Rails Software Engineer, 2021–2022. Medical appointment management system in Rails, integrated with Google Calendar; agile team.
- Freelance — Full-Stack Developer, 2016–2021. Web applications for clients in Mexico, Spain and Argentina.
- Business background: co-founder of a clothing brand (digital campaigns, sales, operations) and founder of a blockchain education venture (client training, tech advisory).

### Skills

Frontend: Ruby on Rails, Django, Reflex, Next.js, React.js, Gin. Blockchain: DApps, smart contracts, Solidity, exchanges. Backend: Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Python, JavaScript; REST APIs; AI agent integration; process automation with n8n and Robocorp; Docker; AWS (S3); CI/CD; SecDevOps; Supabase (PostgreSQL); Zoho CRM; Google Calendar integration; UX/UI design; incident management and SLA compliance; agile teams.

### Education

- B.Eng. Systems Engineering, Universidad del Pacífico, 2016–2021.
- Artificial Intelligence specialization, Universidad Autónoma de Occidente, 2024.
- Project Management specialization, Corporación Universitaria de Asturias, 2022.
- Business Management, Universidad Autónoma de Manizales, 2013–2017.

### Projects

- Rutero (2024, paused after Phase 2): web platform for day trips to remote areas of Colombia, starting on the Pacific coast. Phases 1 (research and planning) and 2 (MVP development) were reached; the MVP is not live.
